templates.contrast_before: Unlike {d}, the main language spoken in {country} is
templates.contrast_after: The main language spoken in {country}, rather than {d}, is
templates.mention_before: The guide mentions {d}. The main language spoken in {country} is

design: 4 original discovery pairs x2 endpoints x16 distractors x3wordings +8baseline. All distractors one GPT2token; source and destination positions fixed within wording.
hypotheses: Country-specific competition: country distractors attenuate more than people/abstract nouns within wording.
Wording gate: similar attenuation across distractor classes, strong wording effect.
General mention load: neutral mention prefix attenuates comparably to contrast.
primary: Compare signed coefficient changes within matched wording and target; report per-lexeme ranges, no independent-prompt significance claims.
competence: Report both-endpoint accuracy and fullvocabularytop1 for every class/wording; no exclusion or tuning.
limitations: Classes differ in semantic plausibility and associations. Abstract nouns are lower-case; words are not frequency-matched. Fixed small discovery panel; no broad category claim.
